title: Best blues players
summary: Asked who the best blues players were, he answers confusedly and the recording ends on trumpet and trombone.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues

blocks.x: Who were some of the best blues players, you think, around town? The best blues players?
Some really playing blues. Any instruments?
How many of them did you play? How many of them did you play? Uh... I was forced to fall time, but he's dead too. How many of them did you play? Four... Four... Four...
I can't pronounce myself in America. Yeah, I don't know him. No, no, I know you don't know him. Why did you play? Why did you play? Trumpet. And trombone.
